MODE 2-6: A·B^X

Base-B exponential regression y = A·B^x.

keys
MODE→2→6

Discrete compound / geometric growth.

formula
y=A⋅Bx

Geometric / discrete compound growth: each step in x multiplies y by the same base B. Different parametrisation from e^X.

steps

Open this type

  1. MODE→2→6
  2. Clear or edit data in the Statistics Editor as needed
  3. AC, then SHIFT 1 (STAT) for Var / Reg / MinMax recalls
